items.detail: Sports Mole reports Chelsea remain cautious over Caicedo, who has not played since a cameo against Brighton on matchday two, and that he could feature at Brentford only if cleared by the medical team.
Henderson has been pictured in training but will only return from a wrist injury after multiple checks, and could otherwise wait until October for his Chelsea debut.

Palestra has missed the start of the season with a quad injury sustained in training and his manager has said the club will not rush him back without assurances over his health, with a bench place at Brentford dependent on his recovery.
Emegha is still yet to play for Chelsea since his summer arrival from Strasbourg and his return date remains unknown.
Chelsea have no players banned for the Premier League trip to Brentford.
Jensen was listed as out with an unspecified issue in Brentford's most recent published absence list, for the gameweek-four trip to Bournemouth.
Van den Berg was listed as out with a groin injury in Brentford's most recent published absence list, for the gameweek-four trip to Bournemouth.
Milambo was listed as out with a knee injury in Brentford's most recent published absence list, for the gameweek-four trip to Bournemouth.
Dasilva was listed as out with a thigh injury in Brentford's most recent published absence list, for the gameweek-four trip to Bournemouth.

news.summary: The freshest fixture-specific reporting is Chelsea-side: Caicedo, Henderson and Palestra are all described as potential returnees whose involvement at the Gtech depends on medical clearance, Emegha has no return date, and the visitors have no suspensions. For Brentford the most recent published absence list (matchday four at Bournemouth) had Mathias Jensen, Sepp van den Berg, Antoni Milambo and Josh Dasilva out; no newer Brentford update was found before the cutoff. No managerial change or midweek cup/European commitment for either club was reported in the sources reviewed, so no rotation item is recorded.
news.searches_note: Searched for Brentford and Chelsea injury/suspension lists, a Brentford v Chelsea preview/team-news piece, Brentford manager fitness updates, and Premier League club-by-club injury pages. Found a Chelsea-vs-Brentford specific list dated roughly 15 September 2026, but no Brentford-vs-Chelsea specific team-news article inside the cutoff window; the Brentford items therefore come from the five-day-old Bournemouth-vs-Brentford round-up and may be stale. Outlet pages showed only relative ages (e.g. '20 hours ago', '5 days ago') rather than visible exact timestamps, so the published dates above are derived from those relative ages and are approximate; the Premier Injuries and Premier League club pages carried no usable dated Brentford detail. Nothing found on managerial changes or rotation-driving midweek fixtures for either club.
